offering_description.value: Sells digital health messaging and patient affordability platforms to pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturers, delivering promotional and savings messages to patients and prescribers through electronic health record systems, pharmacies and digital channels.

primary_products.value: digital messaging platform; prescription savings program; patient affordability tools; data and analytics dashboards

primary_services.value: campaign management; EHR integration; patient support program administration

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturers, healthcare providers and pharmacies that host messaging

revenue_model.value: subscription: platform fees paid by manufacturers for ongoing messaging access; transaction or usage fees: fees per message delivered or per patient savings transaction; service fees: campaign setup and program management paid by manufacturers
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: operates a digital platform connecting drug makers with prescribers and patients; service provider: runs patient affordability and messaging programs sold to pharmaceutical manufacturers

geography_served.value: US national: serves healthcare providers and manufacturers across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: messaging platform, savings programs and analytics, all sold to pharma and healthcare customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales team selling to pharmaceutical manufacturers; partners / resellers: integrations with electronic health record vendors and pharmacy networks

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: HIPAA and health data privacy rules govern patient data use in messaging and savings programs

notes: Company size and regulatory level are judgments from public descriptions of the business.
